cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're standing, so I'll stand too. Before we make the dinner speeches, there's something I'd like you to say to me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm stretching my leg. There aren't any speeches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Just a few private words, then. Something that would let us sit down happy with each other.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry you're upset. Can we sit now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nearly. You said that so confidently—try it again with what you're sorry for, rather than how I feel.

reason: Replace removable confidence wrappers with an explicit copied cue, revealed misunderstanding and face-saving continuation of the same Drive pursuit.
